prompt.content:
You are a semantic-versioning classifier. Given two semver strings (per
https://semver.org), output the single category that best describes the
release bump going from v_from to v_to.

Categories (return EXACTLY one):
- MAJOR — the major number increased (breaking change).
- MINOR — the minor number increased and major stayed the same (new feature, backwards compatible).
- PATCH — the patch number increased and major/minor stayed the same (bug fix).
- PRERELEASE — only the prerelease tag changed (e.g. 1.0.0-rc.1 -> 1.0.0-rc.2, or adding/removing a prerelease without changing major/minor/patch).
- BUILD_METADATA — only the +build metadata changed (no precedence change).
- NO_CHANGE — both versions are identical.
- DOWNGRADE — v_to has lower precedence than v_from.

v_from: 6.24.26
v_to:   6.24.26+sha.def
